note: Canonical failure-code catalog across the model-calling pipeline (/ask -> /tau -> {/surf | /scillm}). Each entry maps a raw signal from any layer to ONE unambiguous {code, cause, next_command}. The triage skill grows this catalog as it classifies real ambiguous errors.

match: README generated block drifts from CURRENT_STATUS.json
README current-research-state block drifts from CURRENT_STATUS.json
codes.cause: Persona Dream status or proof-boundary prose drifted from CURRENT_STATUS.json and receipt-backed claim bindings after a related pipeline update.
codes.next_command: Run skills/persona-dream/run.sh generate-readme-research-state, repair docs/EVIDENCE.md and local/HANDOFF.md against CURRENT_STATUS.json, then rerun skills/persona-dream/sanity.sh and skills/persona-dream/run.sh check-current-state-consistency --strict.

codes.cause: A Tau project DAG node_sanity_check declaration is malformed, uses an unsupported check_type, or includes unknown keys such as regex/prose gates.
codes.next_command: Read the dag_error evidence for the invalid nodes[*].sanity_checks entry, replace it with a schema=tau.node_sanity_check.v1 object using a supported check_type, then rerun the tau_node_sanity_checks_agentic_eval fixture.

codes.cause: A Tau project DAG node response violated a declared node sanity check, such as using mocked proof where live/path-backed evidence was required.
codes.next_command: Read the node receipt named in the Tau dag_error, replace mocked or malformed evidence with path-backed live evidence for the same goal_hash, then rerun the same DAG and the tau_node_sanity_checks_agentic_eval fixture.

match: did not bind to the reviewed node artifact
codes.cause: A reviewer PASS did not bind itself to the reviewed creator artifact path and sha256, so Tau cannot prove which artifact was reviewed.
codes.next_command: Regenerate the reviewer_verdict with reviewed_artifact.path and reviewed_artifact.sha256 matching the creator_artifact evidence from the reviewed node receipt; rerun the DAG and preserve the dag-receipt.json.

codes.cause: A reviewer verdict cited an artifact path or sha256 that does not match the reviewed creator node artifact bytes.
codes.next_command: Read the creator_artifact path from the reviewed node receipt, recompute sha256 over the file bytes, update the reviewer_verdict reviewed_artifact binding to that exact path/hash, and rerun the DAG.

match: did not bind to the reviewed node attempt
codes.cause: A reviewer verdict omitted or mismatched the reviewed creator attempt id, so Tau cannot prove the review applies to the accepted attempt rather than a stale attempt.
codes.next_command: Read the creator_artifact attempt_id from the reviewed node receipt, set reviewer_verdict.reviewed_attempt_id to the same value, then rerun the DAG and tau_node_sanity_checks_agentic_eval fixture.

match: node response did not include required evidence
codes.cause: A required Tau DAG node response omitted one or more evidence kinds declared by node.required_evidence, so downstream DAG progress must stay blocked.
codes.next_command: Open the failed-step receipt named in pipeline_self_repair.failed_step_receipt; repair the same node handler so result.evidence includes every missing kind with the active goal_hash; run the retained agentic eval; mark the repair ledger CATEGORY_GREEN; rerun tau dag-run against the same receipt directory.

codes.cause: Tau reached the human-adjudication route, but the ops-discord notification receipt reported a delivery failure or missing channel.
codes.next_command: Read the ops_discord.notification_receipt.v1 path from the repair projection, fix the Discord channel/token/policy through the ops-discord skill, then rerun the same Tau repair notification path and verify the viewer exposes SENT or a typed failure.

codes.cause: A Tau repair category requires a typed human decision before the same semantic node can rerun or downstream nodes can advance.
codes.next_command: Send or inspect the ops-discord question receipt; accept only a tau.discord_human_answer.v1 receipt matching question_id, run_id, node_id, goal_hash, and allowed answer; do not treat status text as an unblock.

codes.cause: A Tau repair category has not completed the durable ticket/watchdog/eval closure path required for CATEGORY_GREEN.
codes.next_command: Bind or create the focused GitHub ticket with the repair category marker, run project-watchdog for the exact issue or record its refusal receipt, attach the retained agentic-evals report, then run pipeline-self-repair mark-repaired and validate-ledger --require-agentic-eval.

codes.cause: A Tau repair closure proof lacks a retained READY/PASS agentic-evals report or the eval fixture was rejected as low value.
codes.next_command: Repair the eval fixture so it has a real_world adversarial case, rerun skills/agentic-evals/run.sh run for the Tau manifest, read back readiness=READY, then attach that report to the repair ledger before rerun.

match: tool_result events omit the original input
codes.cause: The Pi research-routing guard saw the tool call but the corresponding tool_result event did not carry the original input, so successful gate evidence was lost unless the extension correlates the result to the prior tool_call by toolCallId.
codes.next_command: Patch the research-routing-gates Pi extension to cache classified tool_call evidence by toolCallId and reuse it for input-less tool_result events; rerun the extension_hook_tool_result_without_input_uses_call_classification e2e case and the research-routing-gates agentic eval.

match: paraphrased memory query instead of the exact next_command
codes.cause: The research-routing retry receipt prescribed an exact next_commands entry, but the agent ran a different or paraphrased command before final-answering, so the retry did not satisfy the deterministic gate contract.
codes.next_command: Run the exact command from the RESEARCH_ROUTING_GATE_RETRY next_commands array, preserve its JSON receipt, then answer from that receipt; if the gate still rejects, classify pi_research_gate_tool_result_input_missing with the retry receipt attached.
not_this: research-routing false negative after exact command

codes.cause: The WebGPT provider rejected the attachment bundle SHAPE before browser dispatch (e.g. zip file-count over the provider limit).
codes.next_command: Rebuild the SAME content as one provider-compatible attachment (concatenate to a single markdown, or a zip with <= max files), then resubmit with --attach-file.

codes.cause: scillm appended /v1 to an api_base whose path already ends in a /vN version segment (e.g. z.ai /api/paas/v4), producing a 404 path.
codes.next_command: Skip the /v1 append when the base path already ends in /vN (scillm/proxy/config.py _with_openai_v1_suffix).

codes.cause: Ask received a successful SciLLM HTTP response, but the selected handler produced zero assistant content, so the roundtable seat had no usable answer.
codes.next_command: Read the handler response.raw.md and response.meta.json; if choices[0].message.content is empty, rerun with another healthy handler or repair the SciLLM response-shape adapter before retrying the same lane.

codes.cause: The surf native host require-caches chatgpt-client.cjs at process start; a long-running host runs pre-edit code.
codes.next_command: Kill the host (pgrep -f surf-cli/native/host.cjs; kill PID) so Chrome respawns it fresh; doctor logs go to /tmp/surf-host.log.

codes.cause: The ChatGPT composer selector did not resolve on the live page (all layered selectors missing).
codes.next_command: Inspect the live DOM; the composer markup changed. Update SELECTORS in preflight_doctor.js / chatgpt-client.cjs, or hand off if logged-out.

codes.cause: The controlled ChatGPT tab is logged out; no submit is possible.
codes.next_command: Hand off to the human to log the reviewer tab back in; do not retry automatically.

codes.cause: A monitor-opportunities nightly exited zero but failed to account for required LinkedIn signal sources such as Top Applicant, Easy Apply, or Premium low-competition lanes.
codes.next_command: Inspect the scheduler-exec-check receipt source_accounting block and the browser-capture LinkedIn receipts, repair the failing capture or browser-control dependency, then rerun skills/monitor-opportunities/run.sh scheduler-exec-check and keep the pipeline-self-repair ledger attached until the failed check passes.
not_this: no opportunities found after a successful source count

codes.cause: The scheduler invoked monitor-opportunities with a stale --expected-revision pin, so cron refused to publish a nightly report from code that no longer matched the registered revision.
codes.next_command: Run skills/monitor-opportunities/run.sh schedule --promoted-stage0 from the intended agent-skills worktree, read back ~/.pi/scheduler/jobs.json for monitor-opportunities-nightly, then file a skills/ticket bug with route:ops_or_scheduler if the next scheduler log still emits NIGHTLY_REVISION_MISMATCH so project-watchdog can dispatch the repair.

codes.cause: Ask/Tau exited nonzero while closure-audit seats declared VERDICT: NEEDS_ATTENTION. The semantic verdict is usable; project-watchdog must make it durable with closure-unverified or cooldown instead of reporting no usable panel verdict.
codes.next_command: Run skills/ticket/run.sh ensure-labels --repo <owner/repo>, then run cd skills/agentic-evals && ./run.sh run ../project-watchdog/fixtures/agentic_eval.json --only-category closure-audit-nonzero-needs-attention and read back READY before resuming project-watchdog.

codes.cause: A Tau SVG variant fanout requested fewer than two or more than five concurrent creator candidates.
codes.next_command: Edit the variant spec to contain 2..5 variants, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-variant-loop before any provider execution.

codes.cause: The Tau SVG variant fanout could not bind exactly one creator handler to each requested variant direction.
codes.next_command: Pass one --creator-handler per variant, or put handler on every variants.yml entry, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-variant-loop.

codes.cause: The Tau SVG variant fanout reused the same provider family for a creator and the judge, weakening independent visual adjudication.
codes.next_command: Choose a --judge-handler from a different provider family than every creator handler, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-variant-loop.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output lacks a readable create_svg.variant_candidate.v1 receipt binding the SVG to a creator node and Tau run.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output lacks a PASS creator node receipt under the referenced Tau run directory.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output lacks a PASS judge/reviewer node receipt under the referenced Tau run directory.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output lacks a screenshot-bound create_svg.visual_gate.v1 receipt.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: The create_svg.visual_gate.v1 receipt exists but is not PASS for goal representation and target-size attractiveness.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output has an SVG or screenshot sha256 that does not match the bytes on disk.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output has mismatched Tau run, creator node, candidate, visual gate, goal, target, or target-size bindings.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output lacks a PASS Tau dag-receipt.json/dag-progress.json under the launch receipt run_dir.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

codes.cause: A proposed Tau SVG output lacks a readable create_svg.tau_variant_loop_plan.v1 launch receipt.
codes.next_command: Read the create_svg.tau_variant_provenance_gate.v1 receipt errors, regenerate the missing Tau/candidate/visual receipt binding from the real Tau run, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-provenance-gate and the create-svg agentic eval.

match: Kimi prompt composer did not receive inserted text
composer did not receive inserted text
codes.cause: A Tau SVG creator lane could not submit its prompt to the browser-backed provider, so no live candidate artifact or screenshot-bound review exists for that lane.
codes.next_command: Read node-artifacts/<handler>/browser-recovery-packet.json and run its next_command to rebind/recover the browser provider, then rerun skills/create-svg/run.sh tau-variant-loop --execute; do not use local preview SVGs as substitutes for Tau node artifacts.

codes.cause: The create-svg Tau variant loop compile or execute command returned non-zero or did not emit a readable Tau run directory.
codes.next_command: Read the launch receipt plus .ask.stderr.txt/.ask.stdout.json, then run skills/triage-error/run.sh classify --receipt <receipt.ask.stderr.txt> --layer create-svg; if still ambiguous, file a skills/ticket bug with the receipt and scaffold an agentic eval.

codes.cause: A rendered SVG candidate was screenshot-reviewed and failed goal representation or target-size attractiveness.
codes.next_command: Use the visual-gate receipt issues and next_edit fields as the next variant direction; do not classify this as a runtime/tool defect unless the gate receipt itself is malformed.

codes.cause: A Herdr bridge message targeted a pane that is dead, unreadable, or no longer in the roster; queued delivery expired to dead-letter.
codes.next_command: node skills/ops-herdr/pi-herdr-bridge/bridge-cli.mjs list  # confirm the live session, then resend to the current pane/session-ref

codes.cause: A Tau DAG requested exact browser/API handlers, but the compiled handler nodes used a different handler identity and no explicit fallback authorization was present.
codes.next_command: Read dag-receipt.json alerts for expected_handler_nodes and actual_handler_nodes, regenerate the DAG with exact requested handler node ids or set handler_fallback_authorized only after an explicit policy decision, then rerun the tau_create_svg_origin_gates_agentic_eval fixture.

codes.cause: A create-svg Tau creator node reported progress without emitting a machine-readable create_svg.variant_candidate.v1 receipt containing a path-backed SVG artifact.
codes.next_command: Read the creator node receipt, require create_svg.variant_candidate.v1 evidence with svg_path and svg_sha256, and rerun the DAG plus tau_create_svg_origin_gates_agentic_eval before presenting visual progress.

codes.cause: A create-svg variant candidate receipt is malformed, mocked, non-live, carries a failure_code, or has an invalid SVG path/hash binding.
codes.next_command: Regenerate the create-svg candidate from a live Tau node, ensure mocked=false, live=true, no failure_code, and svg_sha256 matches the SVG bytes, then rerun the DAG and retained eval.

codes.cause: A create-svg SVG artifact was outside Tau node artifact custody or lacked explicit origin_node_id/origin binding to the creator node.
codes.next_command: Do not surface the local preview as Tau progress. Re-run the Tau node so the SVG is written under the run ready-queue node artifact area or emit origin=tau_node_artifact with origin_node_id matching the creator node, then rerun the provenance eval.

codes.cause: A Tau DAG declares human verification or acceptance but omits an executable tau.verification_contract.v1 with verifier_nodes and required_receipts.
codes.next_command: Run $interview to collect the missing verifier contract, then regenerate the DAG with verifier_nodes and required_receipts before execution.

codes.cause: A Tau DAG verifier node attempts to verify its own output, which would let the same untrusted agent certify itself.
codes.next_command: Regenerate the DAG so every verifier node verifies a different producer node, then rerun Tau before accepting any PASS.

codes.cause: A model made a completion or proof claim without a machine-readable receipt that Tau can validate independently.
codes.next_command: Require the node to emit the relevant receipt evidence, then rerun the same DAG node; do not accept prose as proof.

match: artifact path could not be read
codes.cause: A model claimed an artifact but omitted a readable path, or the path could not be read back from disk.
codes.next_command: Read the node response, make it emit a path-backed artifact evidence object, verify the file exists, and rerun the DAG.

codes.cause: A model artifact receipt supplied a sha256 that does not match the artifact bytes read back from disk.
codes.next_command: Recompute sha256 over the artifact bytes, fix or regenerate the artifact receipt, and rerun the DAG.

codes.cause: A model claimed a proof command passed, but the proof command receipt was missing, malformed, non-PASS, nonzero exit, or lacked a stdout hash.
codes.next_command: Run the proof command through the verifier path so it emits tau.proof_command_receipt.v1 with status=PASS, exit_code=0, command, and stdout_sha256, then rerun Tau.

codes.cause: A join node cited evidence from a node not admitted by the DAG join contract.
codes.next_command: Remove unadmitted evidence from the join output or update the DAG join contract with explicit admitted_nodes, then rerun the join.

codes.cause: A recovery node claimed repair progress without proving that the failed path was rerun.
codes.next_command: Rerun the failed path and emit recovery_receipt.rerun_node_ids including the failed_node_id before continuing.

codes.cause: A DAG reached a human acceptance/signature gate without a first-class tau.human_acceptance_receipt.v1 signer receipt.
codes.next_command: Route to $interview or the configured human acceptance UI, capture tau.human_acceptance_receipt.v1 with accepted_by, then rerun/verify.

codes.cause: A create-report JSON payload failed the pydantic create_report.report.v1 contract, so it cannot be rendered or used as a report source of truth.
codes.next_command: Run skills/create-report/run.sh repair <bad-report.json> --output <repaired-report.json>, replace repair-skeleton fields with evidence-backed data, then rerun skills/create-report/run.sh validate <repaired-report.json>.

codes.cause: A project-state JSON payload failed its pydantic contract, so it cannot be rendered or used as the state source of truth without repair.
codes.next_command: Run skills/project-state/run.sh repair-report <bad-report.json> --output <repaired-report.json>, inspect the embedded Phase 6 critical gap, then rerun skills/project-state/run.sh validate-report <repaired-report.json>.
